dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Rustam! What are you doing at the market? I didn't know you could cook!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Ha! My cooking is terrible, honestly. But I promised Zhibek I'd make a salad for her birthday dinner tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Brave man! What do you need to buy?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I need some tomatoes, a few cucumbers, some lettuce, and half a kilogram of cheese. Oh, and some olive oil.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: There's a great vegetable stall just over there. And the cheese seller next to it is excellent. Very cheap too.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Good morning! What can I get for you today?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'd like a kilogram of tomatoes, please. Are these local ones?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Yes, straight from the farm this morning! Very ripe and sweet. How many cucumbers do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Four, please. And how much is the lettuce?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Three heads of lettuce for 500 tenge — or 200 each. How many do you need?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Just one, thanks. Oh — do you have any fresh herbs? Basil or parsley?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: I have parsley — a big bunch for 150 tenge. No basil today, I'm afraid.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I'll take the parsley. How much is everything together?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Tomatoes 800, cucumbers 320, one lettuce 200, parsley 150 — that's 1,470 tenge in total.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Thank you, young man! Good luck with the salad — I'm sure it'll be delicious!

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Rustam — you forgot the cheese and olive oil! The other stall is this way…
